blocks.raw: # Edit a Live Journey
blocks.text: Edit a Live Journey

blocks.raw: ## Use Cases
blocks.text: Use Cases

blocks.raw: Marketer has spotted a mistake in a live journey or a change of strategy has occurred, and brand would want to change some configurations within a live journey.
blocks.text: Marketer has spotted a mistake in a live journey or a change of strategy has occurred, and brand would want to change some configurations within a live journey.

blocks.raw: Initially, for brands to make such a change they would have to create a new journey from scratch and Stop the existing one. This calls for a tedious process from the marketer’s side while also creating a possible overlap of audience with them receiving the incentive or communication more than the intended number of times.
blocks.text: Initially, for brands to make such a change they would have to create a new journey from scratch and Stop the existing one. This calls for a tedious process from the marketer’s side while also creating a possible overlap of audience with them receiving the incentive or communication more than the intended number of times.

blocks.raw: With the help of Edit feature, brands can easily edit a live journey without the hassle of creating a new one from scratch.
blocks.text: With the help of Edit feature, brands can easily edit a live journey without the hassle of creating a new one from scratch.

blocks.raw: ### Editing a live journey
blocks.text: Editing a live journey

blocks.raw: 1. User will be able to modify the contents/configuration of any blocks however you cannot change the structure of the block(add/move/delete any flow control blocks). The following are the editable items within each block in the journey canvas

blocks.raw: ## To edit a live journey, perform the following:
blocks.text: To edit a live journey, perform the following:

blocks.raw: 1. Go to the live journey, click on Edit. Once you click on Edit (on Top right hand side), a new version of the existing journey will be created. Click on Yes to confirm.
blocks.text: Go to the live journey, click on Edit. Once you click on Edit (on Top right hand side), a new version of the existing journey will be created. Click on Yes to confirm.

blocks.raw: ## Approving an edited journey
blocks.text: Approving an edited journey

blocks.raw: As soon as the approver approves this new version (v1), they will be prompted with an option to select **What should be the previous version behavior? Sunset, Stop or Pause**
blocks.text: As soon as the approver approves this new version (v1), they will be prompted with an option to select What should be the previous version behavior? Sunset, Stop or Pause

blocks.raw:
1. **Move customers to new version**-  Existing customers who have joined journey v0 will be moved to journey v1 and will remain in the same block they were in.
2. **Sunset**- Customers who have entered v0 journey will continue to the journey v0 and new customers after v1 is made live, will now enter the journey v1.
3. **Stop**- v0 will be stopped for all customers. Customers who had entered the journey v0 will be exited from the journey. New customers will enter the journey v1.
blocks.text: Move customers to new version-  Existing customers who have joined journey v0 will be moved to journey v1 and will remain in the same block they were in.Sunset- Customers who have entered v0 journey will continue to the journey v0 and new customers after v1 is made live, will now enter the journey v1.Stop- v0 will be stopped for all customers. Customers who had entered the journey v0 will be exited from the journey. New customers will enter the journey v1.

blocks.raw: If the marketer rejects the new version (v1), the original version (v0) will continue to be in a live state.
blocks.text: If the marketer rejects the new version (v1), the original version (v0) will continue to be in a live state.

blocks.raw: **Note**: At any point in time, only one version of a particular journey can be in a live state. Rest all versions can be either in Stop / Sunset / Draft / Awaiting approval / Rejected state, but cannot be in Live state. Also, you can use **Move customers to new version** only when the previous Journey version is Live. If the previous version is stopped, migration is not supported.

blocks.raw: ## Pausing/Stopping/Sunsetting a Live Journey
blocks.text: Pausing/Stopping/Sunsetting a Live Journey

blocks.raw: In addition to editing a journey, users now also have an option to Pause a journey, sunset a journey or stop a journey. Please see below for more details on the behavior of the journey when either of these three options are selected:
blocks.text: In addition to editing a journey, users now also have an option to Pause a journey, sunset a journey or stop a journey. Please see below for more details on the behavior of the journey when either of these three options are selected:

blocks.raw: **Pause Journey:** If a user pauses a current journey, it will be paused for all the customers currently in the journey. All the customers will continue to be in the journey however the next block of the journey will be executed only when the user “Resumes” the journey back.
blocks.text: Pause Journey: If a user pauses a current journey, it will be paused for all the customers currently in the journey. All the customers will continue to be in the journey however the next block of the journey will be executed only when the user “Resumes” the journey back.

blocks.raw: In a paused journey state, no new customers will be allowed to enter a journey.
blocks.text: In a paused journey state, no new customers will be allowed to enter a journey.

blocks.raw:
**Resume a Journey:** This option is only enabled when a journey has previously been paused. If a user resumes a paused journey, the current paused journey will get unpaused. The customers already in the journey will resume back from the stage where they were when the journey was paused and subsequent blocks of the journey will execute for them till the journey state is not changed again.
New customers can now start entering this journey.
blocks.text: Resume a Journey: This option is only enabled when a journey has previously been paused. If a user resumes a paused journey, the current paused journey will get unpaused. The customers already in the journey will resume back from the stage where they were when the journey was paused and subsequent blocks of the journey will execute for them till the journey state is not changed again.New customers can now start entering this journey.

blocks.raw: **Stop a Journey:** If a user selects the **Stop** option, the journey will be stopped and it will end for all the customers present in the journey. No new customers can enter this journey.
blocks.text: Stop a Journey: If a user selects the Stop option, the journey will be stopped and it will end for all the customers present in the journey. No new customers can enter this journey.

blocks.raw: Please note this action cannot be reversed again. A journey once stopped cannot be made live again.
blocks.text: Please note this action cannot be reversed again. A journey once stopped cannot be made live again.

blocks.raw: **Sunset a Journey:** If a user selects **Sunset** option, the journey will be stopped for all new customers. Meaning the customers who were already present in a journey only those will continue to be in that journey and it will continue for them as it is till the journey comes to an end for them. However, no new customers will be allowed in this journey anymore.
blocks.text: Sunset a Journey: If a user selects Sunset option, the journey will be stopped for all new customers. Meaning the customers who were already present in a journey only those will continue to be in that journey and it will continue for them as it is till the journey comes to an end for them. However, no new customers will be allowed in this journey anymore.

blocks.raw: ### Filtering the journeys by version status
blocks.text: Filtering the journeys by version status

blocks.raw: 1. On Journeys listing page, users will see an option to filter the journeys by **Latest version status**. As each journey now could have multiple versions, the filter works on what is the current status (Live/Draft/Sunset/Stop, etc. ) of the latest version of the journey (most recent version).
